item.text:
Audited all 51 verses in `shaam-e-ghariban-3.md`. Corrected the Roman wording where it diverged from the Urdu, standardized nasal endings and izafat, and updated the Roman title to `Shaam-e-Gharibaaṅ`.

The Urdu text and stanza structure are unchanged. The apparent irregularities `غمزدوں کے شام` and `خون کے خطروں` remain reflected in the Roman and are open for editorial review.
